Furthermore, the story actively subverts predictable romantic tropes; for instance, instead of defaulting to a dramatic confrontation with her unfaithful partner or ending up romantically with the brooding, perceptive classmate (which the narrator explicitly notes "would be a lie"), the protagonist undergoes a nuanced, quiet realization about her own need for control and emotional management.
